<template>
	<ReceiptSummary v-slot="{ narrow }" :receipt="receipt"
		><AsamSteps
			:active="active"
			:direction="narrow ? 'vertical' : 'horizontal'"
			:space="narrow ? 88 : undefined"
			finish-status="success"
			class="success-progress"
			><AsamStep
				v-for="step in receipt.steps"
				:key="step.id"
				:title="step.title"
				:status="
					step.state === 'done'
						? 'success'
						: step.state === 'current'
							? 'process'
							: 'wait'
				"
				:aria-current="step.state === 'current' ? 'step' : undefined" /></AsamSteps
	></ReceiptSummary>
</template>
<script setup>
import { computed } from 'vue';
import { AsamSteps, AsamStep } from '@asam-ui/ui';
import ReceiptSummary from './ReceiptSummary.vue';
const props = defineProps({
	receipt: { type: Object, required: true }
});
const active = computed(() =>
	Math.max(
		0,
		props.receipt.steps.findIndex((step) => step.state === 'current')
	)
);
</script>
<style scoped>
.success-progress {
	padding: 32px 16px 12px;
}

.success-progress :deep([class~='el-step__title']) {
	line-height: 2;
}
</style>
export {};
